summary: The bug is fixed. Branch admin Daftar Produk now shows the shared PGS catalog. jombang@pgs.id and jember@pgs.id each see a total of 6618 (store_id pgs-jombang / pgs-jember, 0 own products yet). Shared rows have shared=true, and their price/stock match the branch values from /api/branch-prices (Jombang price differs from Sidoarjo, e.g. pgs-10611 is Rp747.000 at Jombang vs Rp745.000 at Sidoarjo). Search works by name, SKU and product_id. Status filters: empty=1135 (all stock 0), active+inactive=total. Sidoarjo sees 6618 pgs-official rows with no shared flag. Admin with store_id=pgs-jombang gets the same view as the Jombang admin. Isolation holds: GET and duplicate of a shared product by Jombang return 403/404; a bulk edit on a shared product is skipped (0 updated, Sidoarjo doc unchanged); /branch-prices?store_id=pgs-jember returns 403; a foreign store_id on the list is ignored; all /admin/* GETs return non-200 for Jombang. Backend: 24/24 pytest passed. UI at 390px as Jombang: 30 rows, each with pl-shared label and lock icon, 0 duplicate buttons; the locked checkbox does nothing. Tapping a shared row opens /seller/branch-prices?q=pgs-10611 and bp-dialog auto-opens (also works for admin with &store=pgs-jombang). pl-add opens /product-editor/new. Search and filter chips work. Drawer menus match the spec for Jombang, Sidoarjo (wide sidebar) and admin; Chat, Komplain, Beranda Toko, Harga Cabang, Riwayat and Pesanan all navigate correctly. Nothing was saved; no data was changed. One MEDIUM UI bug found: 'Pilih semua' selects the locked shared rows.

minor.issue: Only exports the branch's own products (currently 0), so the branch gets an empty Excel file while the list shows 6618 products. Import also only matches own-store product_ids. This is consistent with isolation, but the UI offers 'Ekspor/Impor Excel' on a list that is 100% shared rows.
For shared rows, 'status' is the Sidoarjo product status. A branch cannot deactivate a shared product only for its own branch. Acceptable, but worth noting.

ui_bugs.issue: toggleAll/allOn (list.tsx:109-110) include shared rows. For Jombang, tapping select-all shows the bulk bar '30 produk dipilih' with Ubah Harga/Stok/Status/Berat/Ukuran, even though every shared row is locked. Any bulk action would skip all 30 rows ('Produk tidak ditemukan di toko ini'). Fix: filter out p.shared in toggleAll/allOn, and disable or hide select-all when no selectable rows are shown.

issues: 'Ekspor Excel'/'Impor Excel' are shown to branch admins, but they only cover own products (an empty export). Hide them for branches, or point them to Harga Cabang Unduh/Unggah.
Filter chips 'Belum ada berat' and 'Belum ada ukuran dus' list 6618 shared rows that a branch cannot fix (weight and dims are owned by Sidoarjo). Hide these chips for branches or explain why.
'Laporan Penjualan' and 'Pengaturan Toko' both route to /seller, the same as Dashboard, so they are duplicate items rather than real screens.
Items with query routes (/chat?side=store, /complaint?scope=store) can never show as active, because usePathname has no query string (minor).
Does not use SellerShell, so there is no sidebar on wide screens (inconsistent with Daftar Produk and Riwayat).
The bottom action area (Batalkan/Preview, Simpan Draft, Simpan & Tambah Baru, Publikasikan) plus the tab bar covers about 40% of the viewport.

branch_admin_feature_gaps: Promosi: Voucher (/admin/vouchers) is admin-only, with no per-branch voucher screen.
Home settings (/admin/home-settings) are admin-only. Branches only have Beranda Toko (/seller/home-sections).
Laporan Penjualan: the detailed /admin/report has no per-branch version. Branches only see the summary cards on the /seller dashboard (the menu item goes to /seller).
Pengaturan Toko: there is no dedicated store settings screen for branches (the menu item goes to /seller). Admin uses /admin/stores.
Push notifications (/admin/push) and product digest are admin-only.
Excel export/import of the shared catalog with branch values: only via Harga Cabang Unduh/Unggah (price), not from Daftar Produk.
A branch cannot set its own product status or weight on shared catalog items.
action_items: MEDIUM: In list.tsx, exclude shared rows from select-all (toggleAll/allOn), and hide or disable pl-select-all when every visible row is shared.
LOW: For branch admins, hide 'Ekspor/Impor Excel' on Daftar Produk or link them to Harga Cabang Unduh/Unggah. Consider hiding the weight/dims filter chips.
LOW: Make 'Laporan Penjualan' and 'Pengaturan Toko' for non-admins go to real screens, or remove these duplicate entries.
LOW: Wrap /seller/branch-prices in SellerShell for a consistent sidebar on wide screens.
INFO: Tell the user which Super Admin features are still missing for branches (see branch_admin_feature_gaps).
critical_code_review_comments: product_bulk.list_products: status=empty for a branch uses $nin over about 5.5k stocked ids. It is fast now (~0.1s), but use an aggregation/$lookup if the catalog grows a lot.

branch-prices list excludes variant products ('variants.0' $exists false), while Daftar Produk includes shared variant products. There are 0 today, but if a shared variant product appears, tapping it opens branch-prices without a match and the dialog will not open.
seed_data_creation: None. Read-only testing; the bulk test on a shared product was skipped by the server, and the Sidoarjo doc was verified unchanged.
context_for_next_testing_agent: UI login: /login with email-input/password-input/login-submit. Grant geolocation (-7.5469,112.2331). pl-select-all needs about 1.5s after rows render before a click registers. Jombang has 0 own products, 6618 shared, 1135 empty; pgs-10611 is Jombang Rp747.000 vs Sidoarjo Rp745.000. Run pytest with EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (falls back to reading frontend/.env).
rca_of_issue: The original bug: list_products queried only {store_id: <branch>}, and branches have 0 own products. It now queries store_id $in [pgs-official, branch] and overlays store_stock price/stock (product_bulk.py:159-192). Verified fixed.
